ns2:course.label: United States since 1932
ns2:course.description: Discusses the New Deal, the Cold War, Franklin D. Roosevelt and subsequent presidents, the structure of American imperialism, and America's role in world politics. Prerequisite: One year of college history, political science, or economics.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One year of college history, political science, or economics.
